items.title: Delhi Police reaches Dipke's Delhi residence ahead of 5 PM Tiranga march
items.summary: Delhi Police personnel reached the Delhi residence where CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke is staying, about three hours before today's 5 PM 'Lehra Do Tiranga' march at Central Park, Connaught Place. NDTV India's breaking reel aired visuals of multiple uniformed police officers gathered outside the residential street with vehicles parked nearby. Aaj Tak's graphic identifies the residence as that of an associate (Anish Gavande) where Dipke is staying. The visit follows Dipke's Thursday claim that police/IB were monitoring his residence and his statement that he was 'ready to go to jail' for waving the national flag. No official Delhi Police statement on the visit or any detention yet; Dipke himself has not confirmed the visit publicly.
